artifacts.notes: Complete strict Eucharistic Canon of the 13 February 1500 Tarazona-use missal printed at Pamplona by Arnaldo Guillén de Brocar (Bizkaia INC-35, PDF pp. 350-354): from the woodcut initial Te igitur at PDF p. 350 col. 1 through Et uoce alta dicit. Per omnia secula seculorum. R. Amen. at PDF p. 354 col. 1 immediately before Oremus preceptis salutaribus / Pater noster. Includes all printed headings, action rubrics, red N. placeholders and 26 printed crosses (✠) under declared selective Latin reading normalization.
